mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak economic growth, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained cycle (INDPRO < 105.0), inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 105.0 periods, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1050 thousand units signal strong residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1050, SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 140000) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 5.0) indicate a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 5.0, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 400000, SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress equity valuations and reduce corporate borrowing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising periods, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
